purpose: Minimum TRUSTED (human_verified or fashionpedia_direct) examples per class and split before a 3/5/3/4 model may be trained.
rationale: test/val >= 30 per class: fewer than ~30 examples makes a per-class F1 too noisy to compare models (one image moves recall by >3 points).
train >= 100 per class: practical floor for fine-tuning a small classification head; below it the class is dominated by the others even with class weights.
These are engineering thresholds chosen for this project, not statistical guarantees; raise them if more data is available.

locked_benchmark.note: A new locked real-product benchmark is needed for the 15-class model; the existing 60-image benchmark has 0 examples of square-neck, collared-neck, sleeveless, none and regular-sleeve.

leakage_control.split_unit: source image (all annotations of one photo stay in the same split)
leakage_control.near_duplicate_hash: 64-bit dHash, Hamming distance <= 4 counted as near-duplicate
leakage_control.rule: a val/test image with a near-duplicate in train is excluded from val/test evaluation; a human-labelled image inherits the split of its source image

queue_oversampling_note: Reviewers reject or mark uncertain a share of candidates, so the queue offers about 3x the number of missing examples (capped by the size of the real candidate pool).
